body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not pay all provider types prospectively or alternatively does not demonstrate that it is not a generally-accepted practice for all provider types, as required by 98.45(m)(1). (Plan Question 4.4.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through April 30, 2026. • The Lead Agency does not pay based on enrollment or alternatively does not provide justification that this is impracticable or is not a generally-accepted practice, as required by 98.45(m)(2). (Plan Question 4.4.1b). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through April 30, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 01/06/2025 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Program Staff Completed Mock-up Screens with brainstorming ideas about how to implement prospective payment and paying on enrollment vs. attendance. These two are to be implemented concurrently. 04/16/2024 2 Weekly meetings held with IT and Program staff 12/18/2024 3 Mass emails sent to child care providers along with a survey to providers to engage them in the process. 09/06/2024 4 Waiver submitted to OCC 08/22/2024 5 Extensive user acceptance testing by program staff and finance completed. 09/20/2024 6 Webinars and virtual office hours held with child care providers and child care staff. Webinar PowerPoint and information added to the website for providers and child care staff. 01/02/2025 7 Full implementation of prospective payments and paying on enrollment vs. attendance ￿ Go Live. 01/06/2025

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not provide grants or contracts for direct services for infants and toddlers, for children in underserved geographic areas, and for children with disabilities, as required by 98.30(b)(1). (Plan Questions 4.1.1c and 4.5.1i). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through April 30, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 01/05/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Implementation Waiver Requested 08/22/2024 2 Implementation Waiver Approved 11/22/2024 3 Identify areas that need supply building for infants/toddlers, children with disabilities and underserved geographic areas. 03/01/2025 4 Conduct a needs assessment with enrolled Quality providers 04/01/2025 5 Determine service gaps. 06/01/2025 6 Hold information session with stakeholders for suggestions on how to maximize existing partnerships. 07/01/2025 7 Develop guidance around acceptable usage of slots, scope of work, etc. Identify internal process. 08/01/2025 8 Set-up agreements with and provide training to the child care providers. Review and update any printed documents and documents for website. 10/01/2025 9 Identify timelines for implementation. 11/01/2025 10 Fully implement. 01/05/2026
